verdict.rationale: Foreloop is a SaaS product-review and feedback platform, so data residency and region selection is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region or any residency control. The only routing evidence concerns sending feedback to a project, which is an adjacent feature and not data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
